name: Patient Summary
description: A patient summary for a mountain clinic: identity and key facts, vitals, allergies and medications, sleep, activity and steps from a wearable, upcoming appointments and visit history, with booking and messaging.

props.name: user
props.type: { name: string; email: string; avatar?: string }
props.description: The signed-in clinician at the foot of the sidebar.

props.name: avatars
props.description: Portrait images keyed by person name, used for the patient and the user. Anyone without one shows initials.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at least the height of the viewport and the page scrolls. Also accepts every other div attribute.
